title: Canonical strict point quotient and cone comparison data
statement: For every automorphism g of Spec D.k, let PointQuotientComparisonData consist of the strict tower natural isomorphism j and the whole-cone natural isomorphism eta of multiplication-cone descent. PointQuotientComparisonNormalized imposes the generator and inverse-generator formulas on every degree, site object and tower level, together with both cone-coordinate identities on every good representative. These properties determine both data fields uniquely: the prescribed inverse determines j, and binary biproduct extensionality on the shifted cone determines eta.hom. Multiplication-cone descent supplies existence for any calculus and Roos model. Define pointQuotientComparisonData by this uniquely determining existence theorem; the auxiliary calculus and Roos model cannot affect either isomorphism.

source.place: Natural Weil isomorphism; point normalization plan, steps 1--6; Deligne Weil II (1.1.7), pp. 150--151

proof.text: Project the tower natural isomorphism and cone natural isomorphism from multiplication-cone descent, retaining its generator, inverse-generator, first cone coordinate and shifted cone coordinate. These are exactly the four factors of PointQuotientComparisonNormalized. The inverse-generator formula determines every component of j inverse by sectionwise extensionality, and uniqueness of inverses determines j. The two cone coordinates determine every component of eta hom by binary biproduct extensionality on the shifted cone, hence eta by uniqueness of its inverse. Thus choosing the specified data chooses a uniquely determined pair, with no arbitrary witness.
